title: Tianlai Instrument Manifest
description: 天籁无界面乐器清单。公共双轴质量状态、来源、音域、奏法和效果字段由 $defs 统一约束，各后端分支只补充自己的专有字段。

assetRelativePosixPath.description: Canonical asset-root-relative POSIX path: no absolute/drive path, backslash, colon, repeated slash, or dot traversal segment.

assetRelativePosixGlob.description: Case-sensitive glob over canonical asset-root-relative POSIX paths. A single star stays within one path segment; a double-star segment may span directories.

onset_overlap_policy.description: How a later written onset is classified while an earlier note is still held. Missing declarations use the conservative fail-closed policy.

articulation_auto_default.description: Instrument-level master default for duration-based automatic articulation selection. It has no effect unless duration_articulation_rules are declared; roster assignments may override the switch explicitly.

duration_articulation_rules.description: Explicit opt-in contracts for replacing an unmarked default articulation according to the deterministic effective gate duration. Supporting an articulation name alone never authorizes automatic substitution.

quality_tier.description: formal means the current bound instrument passed the project's standalone single-instrument acceptance only. It does not imply ensemble, mix, licence, trusted-palette or strict-HQ approval.

collaboration_review_status.description: Independent ensemble/collaboration review axis. It never changes quality_tier, licence policy or trusted-palette membership automatically.

manual_review.description: Deprecated mixed-semantics field retained only for old documents. New manifests use quality_tier plus collaboration_review_status.

pitch_calibration_include_globs.description: Optional allowlist of loaded pitched samples to analyse, expressed as case-sensitive asset-root-relative POSIX globs.

approval_evidence.description: Reserved fail-closed slot. The current protocol cannot approve HQ ranges until compound-variant proof and a strict human-review summary contract exist.

sample_region_exclusions.description: Exact asset-root-relative sample paths whose loaded attack and release regions are removed across all articulations. Every path must match; affected round-robin families are normalized after removal.

sample_gain_db_overrides.description: Additive deterministic dB corrections for exact asset-root-relative sample paths. Corrections are applied after upstream SFZ volume and must match at least one loaded attack or release region across all articulations.
Additive deterministic dB corrections, each explicitly scoped to one VPO sample family. Exact paths fail closed only when that family is selected.
